name: The BAFTA Awards
overview: BAFTA presents awards for film, television and games, including children's entertainment, at a number of annual ceremonies across the UK and in Los Angeles, USA.

seasons.name: British Academy Film Awards
seasons.overview: The British Academy Film Awards or BAFTA Film Awards are presented in an annual award show hosted by the British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA) to honour the best British and international contributions to film.

seasons.name: British Academy Television Awards
seasons.overview: The BAFTA TV Awards, or British Academy Television Awards are presented in an annual award show hosted by the BAFTA. They have been awarded annually since 1955.

seasons.name: Britannia Awards
seasons.overview: The Britannia Awards are presented by BAFTA Los Angeles, a branch of the British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA), as "a bridge between the Hollywood and British production and entertainment business communities."

seasons.name: BAFTA Cymru
seasons.overview: BAFTA Cymru (or BAFTA in Wales or WAFTA ) is the Welsh branch of the British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA) and was founded in 1987.

seasons.name: Children's Awards
seasons.overview: The British Academy Children's Awards are presented in an annual award show hosted by the British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA). They have been awarded annually since 1996. Before that, children's awards were a part of the main British Academy Television Awards.

seasons.name: Television Craft Awards
seasons.overview: Having previously been handed out with the British Academy Television Awards, the awards were established in 2000 as a way to spotlight technical achievements, without being overshadowed by the production categories.
